messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock down owners + timelines for the alert tuning items before EOD.
devon: Agree. Can we list the open items and owners here? I'll take dedupe rules if no one else volunteers. \
maya: Thanks. Draft list: 1) noise suppression for noisy-db-errors (threshold + dedupe), 2) page routing for infra-critical (reduce paging to 1 recipient then escalate), 3) threshold tuning for model-serving OOM alerts, 4) investigate recurring auth-service flaps and create recurring-incident guardrail. \
aj: I'll own #2 (page routing). ETA Thursday COB? \
linda: I'll take #3 (OOM thresholds) — need to run a short history query. ETA Friday noon. \
maya: @devon appreciate you on #1. Can you propose a dedupe window + sample rule? \
devon: Yep. Proposal: dedupe window = 10m for identical alert fingerprint, but still allow one page per 6h for sustained issues. Sample rule I tested:
```yaml
alert: noisy_db_errors
fingerprint: '{{host}}::{{query}}'
dedupe_window: 10m
escalate_if_sustained: 6h
suppress_if_rate: >20/minute
```
This keeps one page for 6hr sustained but suppresses spam bursts. \
maya: That looks reasonable. Two quick asks: 1) run against last 30 days and show how many pages avoided, 2) confirm no db-metrics regression. \
devon: On it. I'll post numbers here by EOD. \
aj: For #2 routing, plan is: initial page to infra-oncall (1 person), wait 5m, then escalate to infra-team (rotation), then to exec if >30m unresolved. Also add automatic fallback to secondary region if primary region reports >3 infra-critical within 10m. \
maya: @aj add the pseudo policy as a PR to ops/playbooks and link here. Also add metrics to validate reduced wakeups. \
aj: Will do. PR link once created. \
me (sre-bot): Reminder: recurring-incident detection is scheduled to run nightly. If a fingerprint reoccurs >3x/week we'll auto-create a follow-up ticket in JIRA. \
linda: For #4 (recurring auth flaps) — I see a pattern tied to deployment spikes. Suggest a temporary grace period on auth 429s during deploy windows and add deploy-correlated filter. \
maya: Good idea. Action items recap: devon (#1) produce 30d analysis + suggested windows by EOD; aj (#2) PR with routing policy by tomorrow; linda (#3 & 4) threshold changes + deploy-exemption draft by Fri noon. I'll own tracking and will ping owners tomorrow morning at 10am standup. \
devon: thumbs up :thumbsup: \
aj: :+1: \
linda: acked. \
maya: Closing loop — I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners and timelines and mark as "remediation-tracking". If anyone sees blockers, ping me directly.
